fields.name: Template
fields.evidence: Toolkit RewardSystem::GiveItems: element FixedString copied from the reward record's FixedString (+0x18 of a 32-byte record) - probably an item template id. Element type is esv::one_time_reward::Reward (named in an IndexedStorage CheckBoundary string).

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: GiveItems: element +4 = the count returned by FUN_1813ce3c0 (number of items still to give).

summary: One-frame request of esv::one_time_reward::RewardSystem::GiveItems (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x13CE600) to send one-time reward items to the camp chest; read by esv::camp::ChestSystem (ProcessSendToCampRequests). GiveItems builds a DynamicArray<esv::one_time_reward::Reward> (8-byte elements) and moves it into this component. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

fields.name: Rewards
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x35B35A0 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes qword +0, qword +8 and dword +0xC (Array shape). GiveItems: the component returned by FUN_1813cd3c0 receives `*p = data; *(int*)(p+8) = capacity; *(int*)(p+0xC) = size` of the local array whose element stride is 8 (this_00 + n*8 - 8 FixedString, -4 int).
